title: Heli-Tremblant

services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: Looking for something out of the ordinary? Discover the stunning scenery of the Laurentians and Mont-Tremblant like you never thought possible through our range of helicopter tours. Our scenic flights are available year-round and last 10, 20, or 30 minutes. Snow-capped mountains, vast lakes and rivers, beautiful sunsets, and vibrant fall colours are even more memorable from a helicopter! Have something in mind? We’ll craft the custom package you’re looking for. Celebrate a birthday, wedding, or prom aboard a helicopter, or plan a fun trip or corporate flight anywhere across Quebec and Ontario. With Héli-Tremblant, anything’s possible! Take off toward the Rivière du Diable and the Tremblant
